card.title: Everything Is Sudden Death
card.instruction: Approach minor choices as elimination rounds where one wrong move ends the entire future.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me choose Nina's birthday emoji. One wrong face and I'm out of her life.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Send a cake. That's what I sent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Matching cakes. She'll have to choose which friend to keep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell her we chose them together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're one entry. Before you send that, are you prepared for both of us never to see her again?

mechanism: A treats a birthday emoji as a survival round in friendship and shared authorship as a combined entry.
confusable: Unlike fear of embarrassment, A must cast the minor choice as selecting who permanently stays or goes.
comparison: S212-b makes collaboration expose both friends to elimination; S212-a makes a tasting offer decide lasting lunch trust.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
